_note: Card modifiers (Yusuf, 2026-10-23): a dealt card rolls a rarity (roll in data/rarity.json) and a rolled card carries modifiers. Blue: one mark (data/marks.json). Yellow: a mark and one powerful modifier, sometimes two (card_mod_second_chance in data/balance.json). Orange: one transmutation, a trade-off that bends a rule of the town. Each entry here is a yellow or orange modifier: cards = the card kinds it can come on; roles (optional) = the roles it fits; needs_leaning = only on a card with a leaning. The townsperson keeps it for life (Unit.boons). Effect keys, summed with the mark's (FolkAI.unit_mod): hp, attack, speed (0.6 = 60% more), carry, gather_mult, build, upkeep (food beyond one person's share), band_weight (counts this many more toward their leaning's band), pick_bonus (dawn cards while they live), idle (never works: stays home), doom_rounds (dies at the end of the round this many rounds after arriving, counting that round), kin_chance (each dawn the chance a plain tribesperson joins free while there is room), kills (kills toward a warrior's promotion on arrival), twin (a second, plain one arrives too). tags describe them for later rules. sim/card_roll.gd.

born_leader.name: Born leader
born_leader.text: counts as two in their leaning's band

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.text: arrives with 4 kills toward becoming a hero

hollow_seer.name: Hollow-eyed seer
hollow_seer.text: one more dawn card while they live, but they never work

bloodsworn.name: Bloodsworn
bloodsworn.text: 60% more health and attack, but dies at the end of their third round

many_mother.name: Mother of many
many_mother.text: most dawns a tribesperson joins free while there is room, but she eats for two

ember_born.name: Ember-born
ember_born.text: builds and crafts twice as fast, but the hearth burns 1 more fuel each night they live
